flow_ref: User story (not in the OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/hook/useODH.tsx (result alert), pages/BatchFurnish/form/BatchFurnishForm.tsx (batch alert); ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/stafffurnish/{StaffFurnishController (200/207), StaffFurnishService (stage RD1/DN1, next processing date, VON sync)}. The following stage cron in ocmsadminprivateapi was not traced for this story.
note: Status Demo paid (50% of 75%). A success prompt exists for single and batch, but its text does not mention the automated follow-up. Furnish/Redirect reset the stage to RD1/DN1 and the next processing date; the content of Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo (cannot verify from repo). Ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Closed, Prod deployed) changed the administration fee on stage reset.
recommendation: Claim partially: the success prompt and stage reset are proven; the prompt text does not tell about the follow-up, and Appendix B cannot be matched from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS shows a success prompt after the update is confirmed
steps.detail: Single: after the API succeeds, the alert '<role> detail has been successfully furnished/updated/redirected.' (useODH.tsx:430-442); on error an error alert (:443-449). Batch: POST with keepBodyOnAppCodeError so the 207 response body is still read (BatchFurnishForm.tsx:113-119); with no failures 'Batch Furnish Applied Successfully to N Notices.' (:192-195), with partial failures a failure-count message (:185-191). The server returns 200 when all succeed, 207 when partial (StaffFurnishController.java:260-263). Same fit as OCMS41.46 step 5. Sesuai.

steps.step: The prompt tells the officer that OCMS will follow up with the offender per the automated processing workflow
steps.detail: The success text only states that the data was furnished/updated/redirected (useODH.tsx:436-442; BatchFurnishForm.tsx:194). There is no sentence about the new stage, next processing date or automated follow-up. A success prompt exists but its text does not serve the purpose 'so the officer knows OCMS will follow up'. Sebagian.

steps.step: Automated follow-up is set up: the notice moves to stage RD1/DN1 with a next processing date
steps.detail: Furnish and Redirect set last/next processing stage = RD1 (owner/hirer) or DN1 (driver) (determineNewStage, StaffFurnishService.java:924-933), recompute the amount payable, zero the administration fee (OCMS-DF-2026-170, Closed) and set next processing date = max(offence date + 7 days, tomorrow 00:00) (:144-158, 238-261), then sync the VON to the Internet side (:262). The Edit path does not change the stage (useODH.tsx:349-376). The following stage cron was not traced for this story, and the content of Appendix B of Annex 1A is not in the repo, so whether the follow-up sequence matches cannot verify from repo. Sebagian.
